## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `ClipCircle-macos.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 | `ClipCircle-windows-setup.exe` (or `ClipCircle-windows.msi`) |
| Android 10+ | `ClipCircle-android.apk` |
| Linux (x86-64) | `ClipCircle-linux-amd64.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The desktop builds are not signed with a paid certificate yet:

- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** in the SmartScreen prompt click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Android:** allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps when asked.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file.
